name: Banco do Estado do Pará S.A
summary: Banco do Estado do Pará S.A. provides various financial products and services for individuals and legal entities in Brazil. The company offers demand, current, salary, benefit, and savings deposit accounts; cards; real estate, installment, business, rural, producer, micro, solar energy, personal, and other lines of credit, as well as income tax and salary advances, and overdraft facilities; and investment funds. It also provides foreign exchange, financial and commercial exchange, bond, fixed income security, debt renegotiation, insurance, automatic salary transfer and debt, collection, ATM, payment management, payroll credit management system, and other services, as well as Internet, mobile…
